_comment: Pooled index-K (kpool=4, 132 B per pooled token). Consecutive rows share a 16-token pooled page when the page-table entries agree, so one page load serves kGroupRows rows. Enabled when pooled context >= min_pooled_ctx or rows >= 96; measured 192 rows: 0.210 -> 0.176 ms at 32K (8192 pooled tokens) and 0.814 -> 0.576 ms at 128K, bit-identical. Set group_rows to 0 to disable.
